title: Spicy Kielbasa Tagine
description: A twist on traditional Moroccan tagine, this spicy kielbasa tagine combines the bold flavors of Thailand with the hearty taste of kielbasa.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add kielbasa and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add onion, garlic, and ginger, and cook until onion is softened, about 5 minutes.
Add red bell pepper and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add chicken broth, fish sauce, brown sugar, cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper.
Stir to combine and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add kielbasa back to the pot and simmer for an additional 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro, if desired.
